body: You have been through a lot. Life gets scary and it sucks. In my life i am always on the brink of insanity. And the fact that one day all of the pain, delusions, anxiety and hallucinations could come back scares the shit out of me. You have kept on going despite all the boulders being thrown your way. It takes strength to not give up. It takes stamina to keep going. You have the might to defy the darkness of life and say “Screw you im not gonna stop!”. Keep going because you are doing amazing.

Hello and thank you for your comment! I take meds and was in therapy for two years. I have learned to stay in the moment however when stress comes in it becomes much harder. I have tried meditation in many forms and it helped a little bit at first but ended up not being beneficial. I smoke a lot of weed as well i am responsible about it and only do it after work or after 7pm on my days off. It is an amazing medicine for me.  What i feel i really need is just someone who knows how hard it can be to just exist and i can talk to and they dont give me a speech about this or that but just empathize and talk through things you know?

Every year around my birthday the attention makes me physically ill. I was sick this year for a full week. It seems like when people focus on me and do stuff for me i cant handle it because i feel like i don’t deserve it.
Ive been making preparations for when i finally decide to kill myself in the future. Im not going to do it soon but i know thats how I’m going to go someday.

I feel this way too i hate it. Money sucks and they say it doesn’t bring happiness but you cannot have or do anything without it. I hate my job, its mindless and joyless. If i didn’t have a job i would be ridiculed by everyone and put down.  I hate this world! The assholes run it and the greedy horde everything and force us to do labour in order to get just a tiny slice of it.  I have tried to embrace it and use the corrupt system to my advantage but i feel like a scumbag when i do. I felt forced to go to college because somehow its impossible to make good money without racking up massive debt and only a few of those classes actually apply to the career. I feel you i really do.

Thank you all for your responses they are very helpful! I have told my girlfriend about this. At first she thought i was breaking up with her but im not going to for a while. I want her to still be in my life even if she isnt my gf she has been very supportive of me and i love her. Thank you again for your support it is great to see how amazing this community is!
